{"path":"cli_tool.py","content":"import argparse
import sys


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="CLI tool with device selection")
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cpu", help="Device to use (cpu or cuda)")
    parser.add_argument("--root", help="Root directory")
    parser.add_argument("--config", help="Config file path")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", "-v", action="store_true", help="Verbose output")
    parser.add_argument("--quiet", "-q", action="store_true", help="Quiet output")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Dry run mode")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-existing", action="store_true", help="Skip existing files")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.device not in ("cpu", "cuda"):
        print(f"error: --device must be 'cpu' or 'cuda', got '{args.device}'", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

    print("ok")
    sys.exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}
